name: Windy Day — Thermal + Crosswind, Open Sky
description: Moderate crosswind with thermals: wind shear at 200m altitude produces vertical velocity gradient. Flock must balance cohesion against wind dispersal.
notes: Wind shear is one of the main environmental drivers of murmuration shape. A strong horizontal wind with vertical shear causes the flock to tilt and elongate in the downwind direction. The shear uniform u_windShear is a vec3 gradient added to wind velocity as a function of y position.
